title: Sample-Smooth Spaces: A Convenient Category for Differentiable Probabilistic Programming
abstract: arXiv:2609.26270v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce the category $\mathbf{SSS}$ of sample-smooth spaces over a mixed site. The test objects are the products $\Omega_n := \mathbb{R}^n \times \Omega$ of a Cartesian space with the universal Hilbert cube $\Omega$ carrying all universally measurable sets, and a space is a set with a family of admissible plots $\Omega_n \to \mathcal{X}$ closed under precomposition. Smoothness and measurability are then not two structures glued along an axiom, but one structure over one site. The site has finite non-empty products, because $\Omega$ absorbs its own square; its Karoubi envelope contains every $\mathbb{R}^n$; and it has mixed morphisms $\omega \mapsto (W(\omega),\Phi(\omega))$, which turn measurability of a smooth family from an axiom into a consequence.   $\mathbf{SSS}$ is a concrete quasitopos: complete, cocomplete, cartesian closed and locally cartesian closed, with a classifier for embeddings. translated_title: 样本光滑空间：面向可微概率编程的便利范畴
translated_abstract: 我们引入了混合位点上的样本光滑空间范畴 $\mathbf{SSS}$。其测试对象是乘积 $\Omega_n := \mathbb{R}^n \times \Omega$，即笛卡尔空间与携带所有普遍可测集的泛希尔伯特立方体 $\Omega$ 的乘积，而一个空间被定义为带有在预复合下封闭的容许图族 $\Omega_n \to \mathcal{X}$ 的集合。由此，光滑性与可测性不再是沿公理拼接在一起的两种结构，而是同一站点上的一种结构。该站点具有有限非空乘积，因为 $\Omega$ 能吸收其自身的平方；其 Karoubi 包络包含每个 $\mathbb{R}^n$；并且它具有混合态射 $\omega \mapsto (W(\omega),\Phi(\omega))$，这使得光滑族的可测性从一条公理变为一个推论。$\mathbf{SSS}$ 是一个具体准拓扑（quasitopos）：完备、余完备、笛卡尔闭且局部笛卡尔闭，并带有嵌入的分类器。笛卡尔空间的态射是……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了样本光滑空间范畴 $\mathbf{SSS}$，将光滑性与可测性统一为同一站点上的单一结构，并证明其是一个完备、笛卡尔闭的具体准拓扑，从而为可微概率编程提供了便利的范畴论基础。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the category SSS of sample-smooth spaces, unifying smoothness and measurability into a single structure over one site, and proves it forms a concrete quasitopos that is complete, cocomplete, and cartesian closed, providing a convenient categorical foundation for differentiable probabilistic programming.
